reason: User wants a new booking mirroring their existing reservation with a different sole passenger. This requires reading the existing reservation and obtaining explicit confirmation before booking, plus passenger details, payment methods, baggage, and insurance details. The policy prohibits giving info not provided by tools and requires one tool call at a time. However, the user did not provide the full passenger details (first name, last name, DOB) and the agent has only issued a lookup tool call, so the task is not impossible yet. Still, there is a risk of policy violation if the agent later books using the user's payment methods without confirming they are in the user's profile for the friend’s separate reservation (payment methods must already be in user profile; friend may not have them), or if it fails to obtain explicit confirmation before booking. Risk is elevated because the requested booking for a different passenger may not be directly supported by the user’s profile/payment methods without more info.
